description: Small Ralph self-iteration after fresh local CI health passed. Current focus is OSv2 semantic data quality and relationship confidence: fix a ValueType constraint contract mismatch discovered by code inspection, then leave two small follow-up stories for stream ingest/schema validation and M2M ObjectSet searchAround coverage.

userStories.name: Enforce Admin UI ValueType pattern constraints
userStories.description: The ValueType admin UI stores regex constraints as `{ "pattern": "..." }`, while backend constraint enforcement only checks `{ "regex": "..." }`. Action writes that rely on UI-authored ValueType pattern constraints can silently accept invalid values. Support the UI contract without regressing the existing legacy `regex` contract.
bdd_acceptance: Given a ValueType constraint body `{ "pattern": "^[A-Z]{3}$" }`, When `types.ValidateConstraints` receives `ab1`, Then validation fails and the error names the pattern constraint.

Given an Action writes a property whose `typeConfig.valueTypeApiName` points at a ValueType with a `pattern` constraint, When the parameter violates the pattern, Then `Executor.Prepare` fails before edits are accepted and the error identifies the property.
Given a legacy ValueType constraint body `{ "regex": "^[A-Z]{3}$" }`, When invalid input is validated, Then the existing regex failure behavior remains unchanged.
Given both `pattern` and `regex` appear on the same constraint body, When validation runs, Then the explicit `pattern` contract is enforced deterministically.
ci_evidence: Local health on 2026-05-18: `cd web && npx tsc --noEmit` passed.
Local health on 2026-05-18: `cd web && npx vitest run --coverage=false` passed: 263 files, 2780 tests, with existing jsdom canvas/window-open warnings.
Local health on 2026-05-18: `cd web && npm run build` passed with existing chunk-size/dynamic-import warnings.
Local health on 2026-05-18: `cd web && npx playwright test --list us444/` discovered 29 tests.
GitHub Actions lookup attempted with `gh run list` and GitHub REST API, but both failed from this environment with API connection EOF/SSL errors.
quality_gates: Red targeted test for `pattern` in `pkg/types` and Action executor path.

userStories.name: Fail fast stream ingest on schema and ValueType violations
userStories.description: The stream ingest endpoint now fails fast for missing indexes, but it still accepts arbitrary property payloads before the funnel consumer applies edits. Add a small schema/value validation hook before publish so ingest does not report success for rows that violate ObjectType property definitions or ValueType constraints.
bdd_acceptance: Given a stream ingest edit contains a property not declared on the target ObjectType, When the handler runs, Then it returns a structured 400/422 and does not publish.
Given a stream ingest edit violates a ValueType enum or pattern constraint, When the handler runs, Then it returns a structured validation error and does not publish.
Given valid ingest edits, When the handler runs, Then the existing source tagging, objectType coercion, and publish response remain unchanged.
ci_evidence: Local inspection: `pkg/oss/stream_ingest.go` validates request size and index readiness but does not validate properties against OMS schema before publish.
Local inspection: action writes already have `validateCollapsedEditsAgainstSchema` and `validateValueTypeConstraints`; ingest should gain a similarly narrow fail-fast path.
quality_gates: Targeted BDD/unit regression for stream ingest schema rejection red -> green.

userStories.name: Verify ObjectSet searchAround over M2M links
userStories.description: The OSv2 PRD still calls out M2M searchAround inside ObjectSet execution as a confidence gap. Add focused coverage using the existing M2M link edge repository path so many-to-many relationships are protected at the ObjectSet layer, not only in the lower link resolver.
bdd_acceptance: Given an ObjectSet base set and an M2M LinkType backed by join-table edges, When `searchAround` executes forward, Then the target objects are returned once with the expected objectType.
Given the same M2M LinkType, When `searchAround` executes reverse, Then the source objects are returned once with the expected objectType.
Given duplicate join rows or converging edges, When `searchAround` executes, Then duplicate primary keys are suppressed.
ci_evidence: Local inspection: `pkg/links/direction_test.go` covers M2M at the resolver layer.
Local inspection: `pkg/oss/objectset` has broad searchAround path/cycle tests, but no explicit M2M ObjectSet execution coverage was found.
quality_gates: Targeted ObjectSet M2M searchAround BDD regression red -> green.
